narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed 51.4% standalone PAT growth in Q4 FY26, but consolidated reported PAT grew 34.4% to ₹10,615 crore.
Operational momentum reflected in Q2 FY27 revenue growing 21.2% YoY to ₹54,270 crore and PAT rising 40.7%.
Despite reported FY26 OCF reaching ₹50,902 crore, heavy capex compressed FCF down 26.9% YoY to ₹6,895 crore.

bull: Q2 FY27 PAT increased 40.7% YoY to ₹7,351 crore on 21.2% revenue growth.
FY26 operating cash flow remained robust at ₹50,902 crore with 5-year cash conversion of 216%.
Debt-to-equity ratio steadily improved from 1.56 in Mar 2022 to 1.31 in Sep 2026.
bear: NGEL missed its 5 GW capacity addition target for FY26, achieving only 2,108 MW by December.
Free cash flow dropped to ₹6,895 crore in FY26 due to ₹49,068 crore in Group capex.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell sharp to 17.0% compared to 30.0% in Q4 FY25.
watch: Execution progress on the planned 9,557 MW capacity addition for FY27.
Sustainability of lower receivable days of 15 days reported in Q1 FY27.
Recovery of EBITDA margins back toward historical 29-30% levels.
